# Subdirectories

* [code-interview](code-interview/index.md) — This directory holds per-brick interview transcripts produced by `pipeline/per-brick-interview`.
* [interaction-history](interaction-history/index.md) — This directory records synthetic histories of important interactions with the `Corpus` agent.

# Concepts

* [Actionable Readiness](actionable-readiness.md) — This file decides whether the corpus is dense enough for serious team use on a defined priority scope.
* [Agent cache discipline](agent-cache-discipline.md) — Claude's prompt cache is **sequential, left-to-right**.
* [Assumptions](assumptions.md)
* [Blocking Questions](blocking-questions.md) — Use this file to track questions that should be asked interactively during corpus kickstart.
* [Corpus Change Log](corpus-changelog.md) — Use this only for major corpus-level changes.
* [Coverage Matrix](coverage-matrix.md)
* [Deep Analysis Plan](deep-analysis-plan.md) — Use this file to coordinate a serious corpus kickstart across multiple analysis lanes.
* [Discovery Coverage](discovery-coverage.md) — This file tracks what the `Corpus` agent has actually covered during kickstart.
* [Generation Log](generation-log.md)
* [Corpus Generation Plan](generation-plan.md)
* [Kickstart Progress](kickstart-progress.md) — Use this file as the live operator cockpit during corpus initialization.
* [Kickstart Report](kickstart-report.md) — This file is filled by the `Corpus` agent during the first kickstart pass.
* [MCP Source Wizard](mcp-source-wizard.md) — Use this file early in corpus kickstart to inventory standard and custom MCP sources.
* [Open Questions](open-questions.md)
* [Source Coverage](source-coverage.yaml) — Historical evidence coverage and freshness by declared source.
* [Source Inventory](source-inventory.md) — Record the sources used to build or enrich the corpus.
